international.title: US envoys expected to meet Putin in Moscow to discuss Ukraine ceasefire - Europe live
international.summary: Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner are attempting to make further progress after earlier talks in Abu Dhabi US envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner are in Moscow this morning, where they are expected to meet Russia’s president Vladimir Putin to advance some of the issues discussed at trilateral talks in Abu Dhabi over the last two days. The meeting is expected to get under way around 9am GMT, with Russia’s deputy foreign minister Sergei Rybakov trying to manage everyone’s expectations by saying it was too early to say that necessary trust had been restored between Russia and Ukraine.
